'''Frostclaw''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Skel]] living on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]]. A violent leader, Frostclaw led attacks on [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] settlers. The Ortolans requested assistance from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. A strike team was dispatched to eliminate the problem. Frostclaw was confronted in his [[Frostclaw's Den|lair]]. Despite the Skel's strength, he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in battle.<ref name="Frostclaw" />

==Behind the scenes==
Frostclaw serves as the boss for the Republic Heroic Mission: ''Frostclaw'' in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on Hoth. This article assumes 100% game completion, so he was killed.
